public_rationale: The records show strong but incomplete ARC performance and an evaluator applying a demanding AGI criterion. They justify caution about calling the demonstration AGI. They do not, by themselves, settle whether the system lacked broad human-level cognitive capability. Supporting the categorical claim would require adopting an additional definition or treating failure to demonstrate AGI as proof of its absence.
limitations: This assesses the categorical wording, not the narrower claim that ARC performance alone did not prove AGI.
Expert agreement is informative but does not replace a defined capability test.
Later released o3 systems are outside the target.

our_interpretation: What we saw refers to the December 20 o3 preview, not subsequently released models.
The ordinary reading of AGI is broad human-level cognitive capability, including learning and solving unfamiliar problems across domains.
Marcus specifies no operational threshold. Neither a particular ARC score nor flawless performance on every easy task is imposed as the definition.
The categorical assertion that the system was not AGI is stronger than saying the demonstration did not establish AGI.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence about the demonstrated system establishes substantial limitations incompatible with broad human-level cognitive capability under the ordinary reading.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evaluations of that same system establish broad human-level cognitive capability across sufficiently varied unfamiliar tasks and domains.

evidence.explanation: The evaluator supplies a stringent criterion involving the inability to construct human-easy, AI-hard tests. Applying that criterion as dispositive would add a threshold that Marcus did not explicitly provide.

The analysis concerns the December results and documents substantial success with remaining failures. Neither incomplete performance nor high performance on this one benchmark settles broad general intelligence.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An explicit operational interpretation of AGI and sufficiently broad evaluations of the December preview that establish whether it meets that interpretation.
